about.title: About
about.subtitle: How the work evolved
about.bio: Angie has spent the last 5 years turning ambiguous problems into shipped products — starting as a first-time PM running field discovery for a Colombian e-commerce distributor, and now leading an AI-automated pipeline built on Google Gemini and LangGraph. Across e-commerce, edtech, regulated supply chains, social, food tech, gaming, ad tech, and enterprise SaaS, the throughline has stayed the same: get close to the people doing the work, hold the MVP line, and ship.

about.bio: En los últimos 5 años, Angie ha convertido problemas ambiguos en productos entregados — empezando como PM primeriza haciendo discovery de campo para un distribuidor de e-commerce colombiano, y hoy liderando un pipeline automatizado con IA construido sobre Google Gemini y LangGraph. En e-commerce, edtech, cadenas de suministro reguladas, social, food tech, gaming, ad tech y SaaS empresarial, el hilo conductor se mantuvo igual: acercarse a las personas que hacen el trabajo, sostener el alcance del MVP, y entregar.
